title: Bad Intel

nodes.speaker: Mizzy Weiss
nodes.text: Well, look who wandered back like a pup this side of the tracks. I'd be a lying shit if I didn't say I was glad to see you. Ready to make some Lims?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, look who wandered back like a pup this side of the tracks. I'd be a lying shit if I didn't say I was glad to see you. Ready to make some Lims?

nodes.speaker: Mizzy Weiss
nodes.text: So you came crawling back, huh?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So you came crawling back, huh?

nodes.speaker: Mizzy Weiss
nodes.text: Oh... yeah... Woah! Did you hear that? What was that? Is that guy watching us? Were you followed here?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh... yeah... Woah! Did you hear that? What was that? Is that guy watching us? Were you followed here?

nodes.speaker: Mizzy Weiss
nodes.text: Ok, look, I had a sure thing on the E-Train yesterday. The afternoon ride in from the outskirts? I'm talking guaranteed data funneled straight from the conductor.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ok, look, I had a sure thing on the E-Train yesterday. The afternoon ride in from the outskirts? I'm talking guaranteed data funneled straight from the conductor.

nodes.speaker: Mizzy Weiss
nodes.text: No fucking way! What a grand piece of wisdom that I haven't ever heard before.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No fucking way! What a grand piece of wisdom that I haven't ever heard before.
Hahahaha.

nodes.speaker: Mizzy Weiss
nodes.text: Lead didn't account for a screamer on the EL car. I'm talking rail skipping, emergency brake pulling nonsense.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Lead didn't account for a screamer on the EL car. I'm talking rail skipping, emergency brake pulling nonsense.

nodes.speaker: Mizzy Weiss
nodes.text: All. Of. It. I lost all of it. I can't even leave this shop to kill the fucker who gave me the lead because I OWE THEM MONEY FOR MY TAB!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: All. Of. It. I lost all of it. I can't even leave this shop to kill the fucker who gave me the lead because I OWE THEM MONEY FOR MY TAB!

nodes.speaker: Mizzy Weiss
nodes.text: Yeah it does! Now I gotta figure out - wait. I have an idea. Maybe you can help me? I was going to teach you how to read the boards afterall.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah it does! Now I gotta figure out - wait. I have an idea. Maybe you can help me? I was going to teach you how to read the boards afterall.

nodes.speaker: Mizzy Weiss
nodes.text: Seriously? Man, I had you all wrong.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Seriously? Man, I had you all wrong.
Asshole.

nodes.speaker: Mizzy Weiss
nodes.text: And what's it to you? You've never seen a dip before?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And what's it to you? You've never seen a dip before?

nodes.speaker: Mizzy Weiss
nodes.text: Lend me a stack so I can get outta this cafe and track down the fucker who gave me the bad info?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Lend me a stack so I can get outta this cafe and track down the fucker who gave me the bad info?

nodes.speaker: Mizzy Weiss
nodes.text: You'll get it back! I'll add ten percent.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You'll get it back! I'll add ten percent.

nodes.speaker: Mizzy Weiss
nodes.text: Blazin' neon, you're the best. When I get my hands on that mother - wait - I have an idea but it involves you doing me a favor.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Blazin' neon, you're the best. When I get my hands on that mother - wait - I have an idea but it involves you doing me a favor.

nodes.speaker: Mizzy Weiss
nodes.text: Really? Not much of a business tycoon are you? No wonder you wanna learn how to read the boards. Tell yah what, do a favor for me instead?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Really? Not much of a business tycoon are you? No wonder you wanna learn how to read the boards. Tell yah what, do a favor for me instead?

nodes.speaker: Mizzy Weiss
nodes.text: Collect money I'm owed. Fucker's avoided the rails since he called an hour delay when there were four cars down. Four. It's an hour delay PER car. Idiot. Rice Walket has always been an idiot and now it's time for him to pay up.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Collect money I'm owed. Fucker's avoided the rails since he called an hour delay when there were four cars down. Four. It's an hour delay PER car. Idiot. Rice Walket has always been an idiot and now it's time for him to pay up.
Just... help someone out, yeah?

nodes.speaker: Mizzy Weiss
nodes.text: Check the sewers. Probably hiding with the rest of the scum.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Check the sewers. Probably hiding with the rest of the scum.

nodes.speaker: Mizzy Weiss
nodes.text: Oh, one of those "only risk what you can lose"-wise guys! A vanilla gambler. Get-my-toes-in-the-water-but-don't-make-me-wet dorks. No, I'm hardcore!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, one of those "only risk what you can lose"-wise guys! A vanilla gambler. Get-my-toes-in-the-water-but-don't-make-me-wet dorks. No, I'm hardcore!
How do we do this?
Are you okay?
No...
Ok, what is going on?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No such thing as a sure thing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No such thing as a sure thing.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: No such thing as a sure thing.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: No such thing as a sure thing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What happened?
...You told me to?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Figured I could make some Lims.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Figured I could make some Lims.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Figured I could make some Lims.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Figured I could make some Lims.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How much did you lose?
Sucks.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Didn't you just go broke from the boards?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Didn't you just go broke from the boards?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Didn't you just go broke from the boards?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Didn't you just go broke from the boards?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm good.
How can I help?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Guess that's two bets you lost.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Guess that's two bets you lost.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Guess that's two bets you lost.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Guess that's two bets you lost.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sorry.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Dip be damned. I know a scam when I see one.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Dip be damned. I know a scam when I see one.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Dip be damned. I know a scam when I see one.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Dip be damned. I know a scam when I see one.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Lend you a thousand Lims?
No.
Fine. Here.
I don't have 1,000 Lims.
What's the favor?
Where can I find him?
What kind of favor?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm sure you could afford it!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm sure you could afford it!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm sure you could afford it!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm sure you could afford it!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why can't you get it?
